Think of someone who wronged you. Now bless them.

Kevin Trudeau recalls a bedtime prayer from childhood: you ask for blessings on the people you love, then you go through the people you were angry with and bless them too, even the teacher who gave you a bad grade.

He says this opens up the windows of heaven and changes your energy. It is a way of letting go without needing the other person to change.

Who would be on your list tonight?

#ad #habits #love #kevintrudeau

Why saying you're fine can bury the feeling.

Kevin Trudeau says positive thinking goes wrong when people say what they don't feel. They are afraid that naming a bad feeling will make it grow, so they say they are wonderful instead.

He compares it to burying the energy in the basement: you aren't getting rid of it, you're just hiding it for a while. His answer is to acknowledge what you are feeling.

How often do you say you're fine when it isn't true?

#ad #mindset #fear #kevintrudeau

What you resist persists. So what do you do instead?

Kevin Trudeau gives a simple order for releasing an old hurt: first acknowledge the feeling, then welcome and accept it without a fight, then allow it to be released.

He says that welcoming the feeling tells the universe you're ready to let it go because it no longer serves you.

Which old feeling have you been fighting instead of welcoming?
